name: VR Build Kit
summary:
VR Build Kit is a spatial design platform. Build or upload a project on vrbuildkit.com, then open it in your headset at real-world scale, placed in the room you are standing in.

In the headset you can:
• Use your hands or Touch controllers: point and pinch to select, pinch with your left hand for the menu, and touch menu buttons with a fingertip
• Walk around a full-size model with passthrough, so you see your real room at the same time
• Select, move and copy pieces, and change sizes in feet, inches or me
